_Would you like to shape the services that help colleagues communicate, collaborate and work productively every day?

_As Service Owner, Collaboration & Productivity, you’ll take end-to-end ownership of these services at GlobalConnect, with Microsoft 365 at the center of your portfolio.

You’ll combine service reliability and governance with the opportunity to shape how our collaboration and productivity services develop over time.

**To Thrive In This Role, You’ll Likely Bring

**

• Several years of experience as a Service Owner, Application Owner, Product Owner or in a similar role, with responsibility for business-critical services or platforms.

• Extensive experience with Microsoft 365 collaboration technologies, including Microsoft Teams, SharePoint, OneDrive, Exchange Online and Microsoft Entra-related dependencies.

• Experience with IT service management and governance, including service transition, incident and problem management, change management and continuous improvement.

• Experience leading cross-functional initiatives and translating business needs into practical, scalable IT solutions.

**About The Role And The Team

**You’ll own the lifecycle of GlobalConnect’s Collaboration & Productivity portfolio, including Microsoft 365, Teams, SharePoint, OneDrive, Exchange Online, Copilot and other strategic collaboration platforms. Your focus will be to keep these business-critical services secure, reliable and well managed, while continuously improving them and helping set the long-term direction for the area.

You’ll be part of the Digital Workplace organization, in a team of 17 colleagues with experience in IT support, system ownership and specialist roles. Working across business and IT, you’ll also partner with Security, Identity Governance & Administration, system owners and external suppliers. Your work will help ensure employees have effective tools for communication, meetings, document collaboration, knowledge sharing and everyday productivity.

**What You’ll Be Working On

**

• Own the service lifecycle across the collaboration and productivity portfolio, ensuring clear governance, documentation, compliance and operational readiness.

• Define and monitor service-level objectives, availability and user experience; follow up on incidents and recurring problems and make improvements.

• Manage licensing, renewals, budget follow-up, cost control and supplier performance.

• Work with business and technical stakeholders to govern access, information sharing, external collaboration, retention and service lifecycles.

• Manage cross-functional change and adoption initiatives, identifying practical opportunities for automation, AI, standardization and better ways of working.

• Act as a subject matter expert and trusted advisor, connecting employee needs with operational, technical, security and strategic priorities.

**Who We Are Looking For

**You bring structure and a pragmatic approach to service management, and you’re comfortable moving between strategic development and day-to-day operational priorities. You build effective working relationships across business and technical teams, and can assess dependencies, risks and competing needs to move work forward. You’re curious about how collaboration services can evolve, including through responsible use of automation and AI.

Does this sound like you? If so, we’d like to hear from you.

**Practical information

**

• The role is based in Denmark.

• GlobalConnect’s standard setup is at least 3 days per week in the office.

• GlobalConnect does not offer relocation packages or work visa sponsorship for this role.

In this role, you’ll have the scope to shape a broad, business-critical portfolio and help make everyday collaboration more secure, reliable and effective for employees.

No need for a personal letter – just send us your CV or LinkedIn profile.

Join us and be part of the transformation in the most exciting company within critical digital infrastructure in Northern Europe! Apply today!

**About Us

**GlobalConnect is one of the leading connectivity providers in Northern Europe. We’re 2000 passionate and talented individuals who want to make a difference, turning our customers’ visions into reality through connectivity. Our goal is to create the best possible conditions for engaged employees, a place where you can develop and grow, and create unforgettable memories and enjoyable experiences.

We have helped develop and digitize societies across the Nordics for more than two decades. Our purpose is what drives us to continue - turning visions into reality by empowering society with connectivity.

**About The Role

**We are looking for Senior DevOps engineer with deep expertise in CI/CD to join our Platform Engineering team in Copenhagen.

This role is focused on modernizing how software is built, tested, packaged, delivered, and deployed across Keepit. You will help define the standards, tooling, and practices that engineering teams across the company use to build and deliver software.

Experience designing CI/CD solutions for multiple teams and working effectively with the engineers who use them is essential for this role.

**You will:

**

• Build reusable GitLab CI/CD components and pipelines used across engineering teams.

• Build and operate highly available platform services and engineering infrastructure, including AWX, HashiCorp Vault, Terraform-based infrastructure, and other services depended on by engineering teams. Our infrastructure spans Proxmox and Kubernetes.

• Create clear, durable documentation that helps engineers understand how our platform works, why decisions were made, and how to use it effectively.

• Operate the runner infrastructure used to build, test, and deploy our software, keeping it reliable, efficient, and secure.

• Build automated tests and validation that allow us to upgrade and change the platform with confidence.

**About You

****Must-haves:

**

• Strong Linux fundamentals, particularly with Debian-based systems and APT.

• Deep understanding of CI/CD concepts and experience designing and maintaining pipelines; GitLab CI/CD experience is preferred.

• Hands-on experience with several of the technologies we use, including containers, Bash, Ansible, Kubernetes, and observability stacks such as LGTM.

• Experience designing tooling, pipelines, or infrastructure used by multiple engineering teams.

• Experience operating and evolving production systems, with the engineering judgment that comes from learning what works and what doesn't.

• Excellent communication skills in English.

• You work carefully and conscientiously, particularly when making changes to systems that other engineers depend on.

**Nice-to-haves:

**

• Understanding of networking fundamentals, including TCP/IP, DNS, VLANs, routing, DHCP, and firewalling.

• Experience using AI-assisted engineering tools effectively, particularly for development, operations, documentation, or knowledge sharing.

• A passion for creating a great developer experience.

• Personal projects, open-source contributions, homelabs, or other evidence of technical curiosity outside your primary responsibilities.

**About Us

**Our platform provides customers with an immutable, historical archive of their data in systems such as Microsoft 365, Google Workspace, Salesforce, Entra ID, Dynamics 365, and Zendesk. We protect our customers against everything, from ransomware to simple accidents. We pride ourselves on backing up hundreds of petabytes of data in a performant, reliable, and predictable way.

**As we collaborate across locations, English is our primary language. Please submit your CV in English to support the review process.

****We offer:

**

• Competitive salary.

• Pension scheme.

• A modern, energetic global work environment.

• Flexible work-life balance supported by a hybrid working model.

• Regular team-building activities.

• Opportunities for professional development and career advancement.

• Compensation is based on experience and skill set.

We kindly ask you not to provide us with any sensitive categories of personal data when applying for a job with us. When applying for the vacancy, Keepit will process your personal data, and therefore we recommend that you also read our privacy policy, which describes our processing of personal data and your rights as a data subject.

**Who We Are

**For over 50 years, we have worked closely with investment and asset managers to become the world’s leading provider of integrated investment management solutions. We are 3,000+ colleagues with a broad range of nationalities, educations, professional experiences, ages, and backgrounds.

SimCorp is an independent subsidiary of the Deutsche Börse Group. Following the mergers with Axioma and Domos, we leverage the combined strength of our brands to provide an industry-leading, full, front-to-back offering for our clients.

**What Makes Us, Us

**Join some of the most innovative thinkers in FinTech as we lead the evolution of financial technology. If you are an innovative, curious, collaborative person who embraces challenges and wants to grow, learn and pursue outcomes with our prestigious financial clients, say Hello to SimCorp!

At its foundation, SimCorp is guided by our values — caring, customer success-driven, collaborative, curious, and courageous. Our people-centered organization focuses on skills development, relationship building, and client success. We take pride in cultivating an environment where all team members can grow, feel heard, valued, and empowered.

If you like what we’re saying, keep reading!

**WHY THIS ROLE IS IMPORTANT TO US

**Our Market Units are where SimCorp meets its clients – and the commercial engine behind them is what turns strategy into growth. As Head of Global Commercial, you will lead the global commercial organisation that powers our front-line Market Unit teams, including Revenue Operations, Sales Enablement and Marketing.

Reporting to Oliver Johnson, Chief Revenue Officer, and working as a peer to our regional Managing Directors, you will lead a commercial transformation with a clear top-line focus: making our Market Units more effective, more productive and better equipped to win. The role is based in EMEA – in London, Copenhagen or Frankfurt.

Success in this role means Market Units that spend more of their time with clients, a commercial organisation where AI and data are part of how every team works, and a commercial model that scales with SimCorp’s growth.

**What You Will Be Responsible For

**

• Commercial transformation: Define and lead a transformation agenda that makes SimCorp’s Market Units across all regions more efficient, scalable and growth-oriented

• Commercial organisation: Lead and develop Revenue Operations, Sales Enablement and Marketing, ensuring each function directly supports front-line performance

• Top-line growth: Improve pipeline generation, sales productivity, win rates and deal velocity across the Market Units

• Operating model: Review and optimise the commercial team set-up and operating model, so people, resources and investment are focused on the highest-impact growth opportunities

• AI and data: Embed AI, automation and data-driven insight into commercial processes – from forecasting and territory planning to enablement and marketing execution

• Stakeholder partnership: Work closely with the Chief Revenue Officer, partner with regional Managing Directors and Market Unit leaders, and establish a commercial cadence and KPIs that give leadership clear transparency on performance

**What We Value

**Most importantly, you can see yourself contributing and thriving in the position described above. How you gained the skills needed for doing that is less important. We expect you to be good at several of the following and be able to - and interested in - learning the rest:

• Experience leading a commercial team transformation end-to-end, with measurable improvements in productivity and growth

• Significant experience driving commercial performance and value creation; scaled experience in Financial Services, Private Equity or Software

• Deep knowledge of financial services and the investment management software market, including the buy-side client landscape, market dynamics and competitors

• Senior leadership of commercial functions such as Revenue Operations, Sales Enablement and/or Marketing, across multiple regions and cultures

• An AI-native mindset, with hands-on experience applying AI, automation and modern go-to-market tooling to commercial teams

• Leadership that builds and inspires high-performing teams, makes difficult decisions with clarity and empathy, and influences senior stakeholders in a matrix organisation

**NEXT STEPS

**Please send us your application in English via our career site as soon as possible, we process incoming applications continually. Please note that only applications sent through our system will be processed. At SimCorp, we recognize that bias can unintentionally occur in the recruitment process. To uphold fairness and equal opportunities for all applicants, we kindly ask you to exclude personal data such as photo, age, or any non-professional information from your application. Thank you for aiding us in our endeavor to mitigate biases in our recruitment process.

For any questions you are welcome to contact Michael Paterson, Talent Acquisition Partner, at MLPN@SimCorp.com . If you are interested in being a part of SimCorp but are not sure this role is suitable, submit your CV anyway. SimCorp is on an exciting growth journey, and our Talent Acquisition Team is ready to assist you discover the right role for you. The approximate time to consider your CV is three weeks.

We are eager to continually improve our talent acquisition process and make everyone’s experience positive and valuable. Therefore, during the process we will ask you to provide your feedback, which is highly appreciated.

SimCorp is an equal-opportunity employer. We are committed to building a culture where diverse perspectives and expertise are integrated into our everyday work. We believe in the continual growth and development of our employees, so that we can provide best-in-class solutions to our clients.

Restaurant Operations Manager

About Us

At Bagel Bites, we believe that good food, excellent customer service, and efficient restaurant management go hand in hand.

Following a restructuring of our management team, we are looking for a responsible, motivated, and flexible employee to take charge of the restaurant's daily operations.

The position combines restaurant management, kitchen duties, customer service, purchasing, and administrative responsibilities. The successful candidate must be willing to take an active role in all aspects of the restaurant's operations, including physically working in the kitchen.

Responsibilities

As Restaurant Operations Manager, you will be responsible for the overall daily operation of the restaurant. Your key responsibilities will include:

• 
Managing and coordinating the restaurant's daily operations.

• 
Supervising employees, delegating tasks, preparing work schedules, and ensuring efficient teamwork.

• 
Preparing and serving fast food, including sandwiches, burgers, bagels, and other menu items.

• 
Actively participating in kitchen activities, food preparation, cleaning, and maintaining hygiene standards.

• 
Purchasing raw materials, ingredients, and other necessary supplies for the restaurant.

• 
Managing inventory, monitoring stock levels, and ensuring the availability of necessary ingredients.

• 
Handling customer service, taking orders, and resolving customer inquiries or complaints.

• 
Developing and implementing marketing initiatives to promote the restaurant.

• 
Managing the company's social media accounts and online presence.

• 
Assisting with financial and administrative tasks, including budgeting, sales monitoring, reporting, and basic accounting.

• 
Ensuring compliance with food safety regulations, hygiene requirements, and company procedures.

Qualifications and Skills

We are looking for a candidate who has:

• 
Relevant education or practical experience in restaurant management, hospitality, or the food service industry.

• 
Experience in kitchen operations and fast-food preparation.

• 
Good organizational and leadership skills, with the ability to manage employees and delegate responsibilities.

• 
Strong customer service and communication skills.

• 
Knowledge of purchasing, inventory management, and supplier coordination.

• 
Basic understanding of financial administration and accounting.

• 
Ability to work independently, take responsibility, and handle multiple tasks.

• 
A flexible and hands-on approach, with willingness to perform both managerial and practical kitchen duties.

Application

If you believe your experience and skills match our requirements, we encourage you to send your application and CV to:

Email: info@sundsult.dk or rkbgaps@gmail.com

Please use the subject line: "Application – Restaurant Operations Manager".

At administrere virksomhedens sociale medier og online tilstedeværelse.

Relevant uddannelse eller praktisk erfaring inden for restaurantledelse, hotel- og restaurationsbranchen eller fødevarebranchen.

Erfaring med køkkendrift og tilberedning af fastfood.

Gode organisatoriske og ledelsesmæssige evner samt erfaring med personaleledelse og uddelegering af arbejdsopgaver.

• 
Kendskab til indkøb, lagerstyring og koordinering med leverandører.

•

lede vej- og stiprojekter gennem hele projektforløbet

udarbejde udbudsmateriale og gennemføre udbud

kontrahere med og koordinere rådgivere, entreprenører, forsyningsselskaber og myndigheder

**Senior Business Consultant, Change Management

****Join NNIT as a Senior Business Consultant in Change Management

**Transformations succeed when people are ready, equipped and motivated to adopt new ways of working. As a Senior Business Consultant in NNIT’s working group for Change & Communication Consulting, you will help clients turn transformation ambitions into sustainable business outcomes.

Change & Communication Consulting is situated within the Life Science Project Consulting (LSPC) department. We deliver standalone and complementary services to project management, supporting clients across the people side of technology, process and organizational transformation.

You’ll join a professional, collaborative department that values quality and customer focus, while also making time for team socials, and casual get-togethers.

Location: This role will be based in Copenhagen, Denmark and will require onsite/office-based presence at customer sites as well as NNIT.

****The Role:

****As a Senior Business Consultant, you will lead change management workstreams in complex transformation programs. You will advise senior stakeholders, shape change strategies, and ensure that affected employees are prepared to adopt and sustain new processes, technologies, and ways of working.

You connect change plans to business benefit realization - ensuring adoption translates into measurable business outcomes, not just completed activities.

You will work closely with project managers, client teams, and colleagues across NNIT. Depending on the engagement, you may lead the change management track, provide strategic advisory support or contribute your expertise to a broader program.

Depending on the experience you bring, the successful candidate will be offered a position as Advanced, Senior, Principal or Managing Consultant.

****Your Responsibilities:

• Develop, implement and lead change strategies, plans, and activities in complex transformation programs.

• Assess organizational readiness, stakeholder needs and project health

• Build and coach sponsor coalitions to ensure visible, active leadership of the change

• Plan and coordinate communication, training and engagement activities

• Define and track adoption and readiness metrics

• Identify risks, resistance and adoption barriers, and develop practical responses

• Facilitate workshops with teams, functions and stakeholders across cultures.

• Translate transformation objectives into clear messages and actionable change activities

• Support the development of proposals, Request for Proposals, Statements of Work, client presentations, use cases, and thought leadership.

• Mentor and support consulting talent of tomorrow in junior-senior setups

• Contribute to the continued development of change and communication methods, tools and services.

Our approach is anchored in the Prosci® framework, while remaining adaptable to each client’s context, objectives, and needs.

****Your Qualifications:

****We are looking for an experienced profile who combines strong change management expertise with sound business understanding and the ability to work confidently with senior stakeholders.

Preference will be given to candidates with experience in delivering complex change management projects within the Life Science sector. You may have worked as a Change Manager, Transformation Consultant, Senior Consultant, Project Manager, or in a similar role.

**We Expect That You Will Have:

**

• Several years of experience with change management methods, tools, and processes

• Strong stakeholder management and communication skills

• The ability to translate complex changes into clear actions and messages

• Experience with communication planning, training, and adoption activities

• Experience integrating change plans with a project's delivery methodology (agile, hybrid or waterfall) so change activities land at the right time

• Experience with advisory, presales, proposals, or commercial support

• Strong facilitation skills and confidence working with senior stakeholders

• Confidence working independently while collaborating across multidisciplinary teams

• Excellent English skills, both written and spoken

**It Is a Distinct Advantage If You:

**

• Have experience working in or for regulated industries such as life science or finance.

• Understand digital transformation in Regulatory, Safety, Clinical, or related life science areas.

• Are a Prosci® Certified Change Practitioner.

• Have experience from consultancy or customer-facing roles

• Are curious about human behavior, learning, culture and group dynamics.

• Are a well-liked colleague.

****Your Personal Profile:

****You are motivated by helping people and organizations succeed with change. You create clarity, build trust, and help stakeholders understand what is changing, why it matters, and how to move forward.

You are proactive, structured, and able to balance strategic direction with practical execution. You communicate clearly, collaborate naturally, and take responsibility for delivering results together with your team and customers.

****Why Join NNIT:

****At NNIT, you will join a company with strong roots in IT services, digital transformation, and regulated industries. We help customers develop, implement, and manage business critical solutions with high demands for quality, security, and reliability.

**We Offer:

**

• A professional and collaborative working environment

• Opportunities to work on meaningful projects for leading customers

• Skilled colleagues with strong business and technology expertise

• Room to grow your career and develop your consulting and change management capabilities

• A culture built on responsibility, respect, and delivering quality

****About NNIT:

****NNIT is a leading provider of IT services and consulting. We deliver solutions that support digital transformation and business critical processes for customers in Denmark and internationally. Our work is guided by a strong commitment to quality, trust, and long-term customer relationships.

**Apply now

**If you are ready to help organizations succeed with change, we look forward to hearing from you.

Please submit your CV and application through our recruitment system. We review applications on an ongoing basis.

****About NNIT

****NNIT is a publicly listed company that specializes in IT solutions to life sciences internationally, and to the public and enterprise sectors in Denmark. We focus on high complexity industries and thrive in environments where regulatory demands and complexity are high. We advise on and build sustainable digital solutions that work for the patients, citizens, employees, end users or customers.

NNIT consists of group company NNIT A/S and subsidiaries SCALES, Excellis Health Solutions and SL Controls. Together, these companies employ more than 1,600 people in Europe, Asia, and USA.

We celebrate diversity and are dedicated to fostering an inclusive environment for all employees. _Are you skilled at turning financial information into a clear performance story? Can you move confidently from the detail behind the numbers to the insights that matter most? Do you thrive in a fast-paced environment with senior stakeholder exposure?

_The Group FP&A function owns and steers the financial performance of Pandora. The function plays a vital role in defining and enforcing the global performance management framework and policies across Global Finance and within the business – including being the driver of planning, budgeting and forecasting, defining KPIs and management reporting to the CFO and CEO. The function is therefore key to Pandora’s ability to provide the right guidance on expected future performance to the capital markets.

As Senior Manager, FP&A Reporting, you will play a key role in Pandora’s Group performance reporting, translating financial results and underlying business drivers into clear, decision-relevant insights for the CFO and CEO.

You will play a key role in the end-to-end performance reporting cycle, turning performance trends and underlying drivers into sharp insights, recommendations and actions. Working closely with Group Reporting & Accounting, Group Commercial Finance and stakeholders across Pandora, you will combine strong financial foundations with sound business judgement to turn complexity into clarity.

**Key Responsibilities

**

• Own and continuously develop Pandora’s end-to-end Group performance reporting, including clear and decision-relevant commentary.

• Lead the preparation of the monthly and quarterly Group Business Performance Reviews and closing reviews delivering a high-quality reporting pack that clearly highlights key results, business drivers, risks and opportunities.

• Prepare executive and Board reporting, translating financial information into concise, actionable insights.

• Coordinate FP&A activities related to monthly, quarterly and annual closing in close partnership with Group Reporting & Accounting and other Finance teams.

• Analyze performance against budget, forecast and prior periods, including key drivers across revenue, gross margin, costs and cash flow.

• Play a key role in the governance and reporting of like-for-like performance, including system logic and definitions, ensuring LFL is consistently applied as a key performance measure.

• Serve as the centre of excellence for Group reporting methodology and the management reporting package, ensuring one set of numbers

• Partner with our Global Cost Transformation office on reporting and follow-up of initiatives and financial benefits.

• Continuously improve the structure, content and quality of Group performance reporting and commentary, driving simplification, standardization and automation across reporting processes and ways of working.

**What We’re Looking For

**You are a business-minded finance professional with a strong technical foundations and the ability to turn detailed analysis into a compelling executive-level performance story.

**What You Bring

**

• Relevant experience from a similar role within Group Finance, FP&A or controlling in a larger international organization.

• A robust accounting foundation and a solid understanding of the P&L, balance sheet and cash flow, including working capital.

• Experience with monthly closing, Group consolidation, management reporting and performance-review processes.

• Proven ability to translate financial results into clear, concise insights for CFO and/or Board-level audiences.

• Sound business acumen and judgement, with the confidence to challenge assumptions and focus on what matters most.

• Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence and align stakeholders at all levels.

• A proactive mindset, anticipating needs and raising issues and opportunities early rather than simply reacting to requests.

• A track record of improving, simplifying or automating finance and reporting processes, supported by advanced systems, Excel and PowerPoint skills.

• Comfort working in a complex international environment with multiple stakeholders and competing priorities.

**Additional Information

**

• Career Band 4A

**Did we get your attention?

**If you see yourself in the position and would like to become a part of Pandora’s future, please do not hesitate to apply. We look forward to hearing from you!

We process applications on a continuous basis, which is why we encourage you to send your application as soon as possible.

You can also read more about Pandora on our corporate site www.pandoragroup.com.

**About Pandora

**Pandora is the world's largest jewellery brand, specialising in the design, crafting and marketing of accessible luxury jewellery made from high-quality materials. Each piece is created to inspire self-expression, allowing people to share their stories and passions through meaningful jewellery. Pandora jewellery is sold in more than 100 countries through 7,000 points of sale, including more than 2,800 concept stores.

Headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark, Pandora employs around 39,000 people worldwide and crafts its jewellery with 100% recycled silver and gold. Pandora is committed to leadership in sustainability and has set out to halve greenhouse gas emissions across its value chain by 2030. Pandora is listed on the Nasdaq Copenhagen stock exchange and generated revenue of DKK 32.5 billion (EUR 4.4 billion) in 2025.

Recognised by the Financial Times as one of Europe’s Best Workplaces and ranked #1 among Danish companies, Pandora is committed to building an inclusive and diverse workplace. We believe that reflecting the diversity of society in how we engage with our customers is essential to fulfilling our purpose: to give a voice to people’s loves. We are dedicated to nurturing a culture where everyone feels respected, valued.

Build Continia’s test function from the ground up, and shape how we deliver quality across all our products.

Continia develops finance automation software built on Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central, .NET, web and mobile technologies. Our solutions for accounts payable automation, e-documents, expense management and bank integration help more than 20,000 customers worldwide automate everyday finance processes, delivered through a global network of more than 1,800 reselling partners.

As our products grow and increasingly ship together as a Continia Suite, quality across them matters more than ever. That is why we are building a new test function, and we are looking for the person who will lead it. You will set the direction, build the processes and lay the foundation for the team.

About the role

Our developers own the quality of their own code through unit and integration tests. What no single team owns today is the view across products. Does a change in one product affect another? Does the Continia Suite work as a whole? Are we ready to release? That is what this function is for, and you will be the one to build it.

You start by creating the roadmap. Where are our biggest quality challenges, which processes do we need, and what are the milestones? From there you build the function step by step. You keep it transparent where we are and when we need people from the product teams. You will work closely with our QA & Automation Engineer to decide what to automate and where AI can make our test processes faster.

A big part of the role is people. You will be the link between support, escalation engineers, developers and product managers. You listen to what they see, bring the right people together and turn what you learn into better testing.

What you’ll be doing

• Build the test function from scratch, including the roadmap, milestones, processes and, over time, the team.

• Define test strategy, quality criteria and release readiness with product managers and engineering managers.

• Own regression and coordinate testing across our all our products, so nothing is skipped before we ship.

• Work closely with support, escalation engineers, developers and product managers, and turn what they see into better testing.

• Work with UX to make sure new features are easy to understand and intuitive for users, not just that they meet the user story.

• Find the edge cases others miss, and match test depth to risk.

• Report quality trends and progress to leadership.

About you

• Experience leading QA or test work, ideally including building a test function or team from the ground up.

• Extensive software testing experience or QA, including test strategy for complex business applications.

• Practical experience using AI to improve test processes.

• Experience with ERP or finance software. Dynamics 365 Business Central is a strong advantage.

• Structured by nature. You create clarity, set up processes that last, and can say “not ready” with evidence while staying a good colleague to the teams you work with.

• ISTQB or a similar certification is an advantage.

• Fluent in English, written and spoken. Danish language skills are an advantage, but not required.

What we offer

At Continia, you’ll join an informal and collaborative environment where you’ll be empowered to grow professionally and personally.

• Competitive compensation package.

• A culture based on trust, responsibility and collaboration, where your ideas are taken seriously.

• Opportunities for professional growth and learning.

• A strong social environment where we celebrate successes and have fun together.

• Memorable company events with colleagues from around the world.

• Work at the intersection of technology and business, with an impact you can see.

The position is based at our office in Aalborg, and we expect you to be on site three days a week. The role is about working closely with support, developers and product teams, and being close to them makes it easier to keep a finger on the pulse and build strong relationships.

How to apply

If this sounds like the right opportunity for you, please upload your CV along with a short motivation for your application.

Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis. For questions about the position, please contact Senior Product Manager, Josefine Franck Christensen at jf@continia.com.

Continia is committed to an inclusive recruitment process and equal opportunities for all applicants with a Danish residence and work permit.

For GDPR and processing reasons, all applications and CVs must be uploaded via the provided link and not sent via email or otherwise.

About Continia

At Continia, we value diversity and encourage authenticity. We are team players who respect each other’s thoughts and ideas, and we expect everyone to take ownership of their work. We focus on personal and professional development to grow internally within our organization.

In our day-to-day work, we are pragmatic and result-oriented, and we aim to stay entrepreneurial by keeping things simple and focusing on our employees. We celebrate our wins and releases and aim to have one major event each year where all employees meet up in one place.

We recognize that time is what matters most. Continia solutions give customers more time every day to work and live. That’s why “It’s About Time” is our motto. Our success is built on partnering with more than 1,800 reselling partners, serving more than 20,000 customers worldwide.

jobs.occupation: Director, Team Lead Late-Stage CMC Project Management
jobs.description:
At Genmab, we are dedicated to building extra[not]ordinary® futures, together, by developing antibody products and groundbreaking, knock-your-socks-off KYSO antibody medicines® that change lives and the future of cancer treatment and serious diseases. We strive to create, champion and maintain a global workplace where individuals’ unique contributions are valued and drive innovative solutions to meet the needs of our patients, care partners, families and employees.

Our people are compassionate, candid, and purposeful, and our business is innovative and rooted in science. We believe that being proudly authentic and determined to be our best is essential to fulfilling our purpose. Yes, our work is incredibly serious and impactful, but we have big ambitions, bring a ton of care to pursuing them, and have a lot of fun while doing so.

Does this inspire you and feel like a fit? Then we would love to have you join us!

At Genmab, we’re committed to building extra[not]ordinary futures together, by developing antibody products and pioneering, knock-your-socks-off therapies that change the lives of patients and the future of cancer treatment and serious diseases. From our people who are caring, candid, and impact-driven to our business, which is innovative and rooted in science, we believe that being proudly unique, determined to be our best, and authentic is essential to fulfilling our purpose.

**The Role and Department

**The Late Stage CMC Project organization is growing and we are looking for 2 Directors to lead and develop a team of Project Managers in Genmab’s late-stage CMC project organization.

The roles have similar responsibility and you will combine people leadership with strategic oversight and hands-on responsibility for complex CMC programs, including contribution to governance of outsourced activities with contract development and manufacturing organizations (CDMOs).

Both postions report to the Senior Director, Head of the Late-Stage Project Management Office, within Genmab Tech Ops in Denmark. Working closely with CMC, Regulatory Affairs, Quality and Supply Chain, you will align CMC delivery with development priorities and drive progress towards regulatory submission and commercial readiness.

You will help shape the late-stage project organization, develop experienced Project Managers and translate portfolio priorities into clear decisions and reliable delivery.

**Responsibilities

**Team leadership and development

• Lead and develop your team through resource planning, recruitment, performance management and succession planning, building capabilities for current and future portfolio needs

• Coach Project Managers in strategic thinking, cross-functional leadership and resolving complex CMC challenges. Set clear expectations, delegate effectively and build accountability for results

• Work closely with the Senior Director to prioritize resources and budgets across the team’s programs, resolve capacity constraints and align delivery with portfolio objectives

CMC strategy and project responsibilities

• Shape CMC strategies with technical and functional leads, aligned with overall Drug Development Plans. Lead assigned programs through integrated planning, budget analysis and management of cross-program dependencies.

• Drive cross-functional delivery of technology transfer, process validation, manufacturing readiness and submission documentation, with clear ownership and adherence to Genmab’s quality system and applicable regulatory requirements

• Ensure reliable plans, risk and decision logs, and executive reporting. Anticipate portfolio impacts, resolve high-impact issues and facilitate data-driven options and recommendations to senior governance forums

• Lead improvements to the Project Manual, governance and ways of working, including digital and AI-enabled tools that strengthen planning, risk management and delivery

**CDMO collaboration and project governance

**

• Representing Late Stage CMC Project Management in CDMO joint project and steering committees, facilitating strategic discussions and decisions within delegated authority. Ensure decisions translate into clear commitments and follow-through

• Shape outsourcing and partnership strategies with relevant functions, aligning proposals, contracts and quality agreements with program objectives, business needs and intellectual property considerations

• Hold partners accountable for agreed scope, quality, timelines and budgets. Build transparent relationships, resolve vendor conflicts and escalate strategic trade-offs and risks with clear recommendations

**Requirements

**

• Master’s degree or higher in natural sciences, pharmacy, engineering or a related discipline, or equivalent experience

• Extensive biopharmaceutical CMC experience, including late-stage biologics development and progression towards commercial supply. Experience with antibody-drug conjugates is an advantage

• Proven experience shaping strategies and leading complex global CMC programs, including portfolio prioritization, strategic budget management and cross-functional risk resolution

• Established people-leadership experience, with a track record of developing Project Managers, building team capabilities and supporting talent and succession planning

• Strong understanding of technology transfer, process validation, submission strategies and the interdependencies between development, manufacturing and supply

• Experience shaping outsourcing strategies, leading CDMO governance and resolving complex partner issues with sound business judgment

• Advanced knowledge of GMP and global CMC regulatory expectations, including those relevant to FDA, EMA and NMPA submissions

• Excellent English communication skills, with a track record of influencing senior stakeholders and translating complex issues into clear business recommendations.

**About You

**You combine strategic perspective with the judgment to know when to engage directly and when to empower others. You develop people, set clear priorities and make well-founded decisions under uncertainty, balancing quality, timelines and cost.

You build trust across functions and cultures, challenge assumptions constructively and create an inclusive environment where colleagues take ownership. You champion a ONE-Team approach, welcome feedback and turn lessons learned into improvements across the project organization.

**Location and Travel

**The role is based in Denmark. Travel is expected to be approximately 10–15 days per year.

Genmab leverages the effectiveness of an agile working environment, when possible, for the betterment of employee work-life balance. Our offices are designed as open, community-based spaces that work to connect our employees. Whether you’re in one of our collaboratively designed office spaces or working remotely, we thrive on connecting with each other to innovate.

The proposed gross annual/hourly base salary range for this position, in the primary location, based on a full time schedule is:

DKK883.200,00---1.324.800,00

The final salary offer will depend on several factors, including your skills, qualifications, and experience.

In addition to base salary, this position is eligible for additional forms of compensation, such as discretionary bonuses and long-term incentives.

**Benefits

**When you join Genmab, you become a part of a culture that supports your physical, financial, social, and emotional well-being. Our benefits include, but are not limited to:

• Pension

• Health insurance and wellness benefits

• Paid time off

• Employee support programs

Further details on eligibility for compensation and benefits based on the role will be provided during the recruitment process.

**About Genmab

**Genmab is an international biotechnology company with a core purpose to improve the lives of patients through innovative and differentiated antibody therapeutics. For 25 years, its hard-working, innovative and collaborative team has invented next-generation antibody technology platforms and harnessed translational, quantitative and data sciences, resulting in a proprietary pipeline including bispecific T-cell engagers, antibody-drug conjugates, next-generation immune checkpoint modulators and effector function-enhanced antibodies. By 2030, Genmab’s vision is to transform the lives of people with cancer and other serious diseases with Knock-Your-Socks-Off (KYSO®) antibody medicines.

Established in 1999, Genmab is headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark with international presence across North America, Europe and Asia Pacific. For more information, please visit Genmab.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

Genmab is committed to protecting your personal data and privacy. Please see our privacy policy for handling your data in connection with your application on our website Job Applicant Privacy Notice (genmab.com).

Do you have experience developing medical devices? Would you like to be part of developing innovative products that make a meaningful difference to patients, while applying your skills in a global MedTech company that is helping shape the future of endoscopy?

Then your next career move could be as a Systems Engineer with Ambu.

**Be a Key Player in Engineering & Imaging

**In this exciting role, you will be a key contributor within our R&D organization and a leading technical member of a product development project. You will play a central role in shaping and delivering innovative endoscopy solutions, directly contributing to Ambu’s future success and to improved outcomes for patients and healthcare professionals.

As part of this position, you will join a team responsible for developing a go-to-market solution that introduces new product features AI capabilities to our existing portfolio of display units. This will enable us to gain valuable experience with AI-enabled solutions while preparing for the development of our next-generation display unit. The solution will support our current portfolio of endoscopy products while also laying the foundation for future platforms, capabilities, and product offerings.

You will be part of our Global Systems Engineering department and report to the Systems Engineering Team Manager. The position is based at our headquarter in Ballerup, Denmark, where you will join a collaborative, professional, and globally connected team.

We foster a strong culture of innovation, with a clear focus on fast time-to-market while remaining deeply committed to developing the right products to meet customer and user needs, ultimately improving patient care. This requires the ability to navigate complex medical device development and bring different technologies, disciplines, and perspectives together into coherent product solutions.

You will join a truly global Systems Engineering team of 22 highly skilled and motivated colleagues based across different locations. The team is part of Engineering & Imaging within our R&D organization and brings together a diverse mix of backgrounds, perspectives, and expertise. What really stands out is the team’s strong collaborative spirit and proven track record of successfully bringing Ambu’s innovative products to market, making it a great environment in which to learn, grow, and contribute.

**Global, User-Driven Innovation: From Idea to Launch

**As a Systems Engineer, you will hold the overall technical view of the product and help subject matter experts, project team members, and other stakeholders understand each other and work effectively together.

You will be leading technical alignment and discussions in the project team to find the right solution , helping drive and maintain the overall technical solution and ensuring coherence across the different technologies and disciplines involved. You will navigate technical trade-offs, facilitate decisions, and ensure that the product solution remains aligned with user needs, business objectives, regulatory requirements, and the overall system architecture.

You will create, facilitate, and review key product development documentation, including requirements, design inputs, design outputs, and technical reviews. You enjoy working in cross-functional project teams, finding pragmatic solutions to complex technical challenges, and ensuring an appropriate level of documentation and technical rigor.

You will be involved throughout the product development lifecycle, from early scope investigation and concept development through design, integration, verification and validation, and ultimately market launch.

We work in a hybrid setup, typically with minimum three days on-site in Ballerup, providing flexibility while maintaining strong team connections.

**Your Responsibilities

**

• Define, plan, document, and technically manage product development activities within the project to ensure the product is delivered in accordance with the defined design objectives and development plan.

• Identify and understand stakeholder and user needs through engagement with key stakeholders and users.

• Analyze and decompose user needs, business needs, and system requirements into clear and actionable product and development requirements.

• Leading technical alignment and discussions with the Project Manager and relevant Line Managers.

• Ensure alignment with product and technology architectures and promote the appropriate reuse of existing design solutions across the R&D organization.

• Investigate and scope new product concepts and solutions within existing or new clinical areas, building on Ambu’s technologies and capabilities.

• Establish and maintain the overall technical overview of the product, including system interfaces, dependencies, and trade-offs between technologies and design solutions.

• Ensure development, documentation, verification, and testing activities are performed in accordance with applicable FDA, ISO, IEC, and internal quality requirements.

Your stakeholder base will be broad, and you will collaborate across Ambu’s global organization, with functions involved throughout product development, as well as externally with users, knowledge centers, technical partners, and suppliers.

Our production sites are located in Malaysia, China, the USA, and Mexico, and we collaborate with KOLs and development centers across Europe, Asia, and the US. Some travel should therefore be expected, approximately 20 days per year.

**Suggested Candidate Profile

**Setting you up for success is one of our cornerstones. We imagine that you are proactive, driven, committed, and comfortable taking responsibility and ownership. You are thorough and quality-minded, with strong interpersonal skills and good situational awareness, enabling you to work effectively in cross-functional and global teams.

**Skills

**Skills and experience can be gained in many different ways, and we understand that the best fit for a role cannot always be defined on paper. That said, you are likely to thrive in this role if you bring:

• A degree or professional background in electrical engineering, mechatronics, mechanical engineering, biomedical engineering, or a similar technical field, together with relevant hands-on product development experience.

• Experience developing medical devices, including working with design control and requirements in a regulated environment, or comparable experience from another highly regulated industry.

• Experience in cross-functional product development involving hardware, electronics, mechanics, and software, ideally within medical devices or a related engineering or consultancy environment.

• A strong systems engineering mindset combined with a practical approach to developing robust and reliable product solutions.

• The ability to work independently, take ownership, and remain pragmatic and solution-oriented while actively sharing knowledge and collaborating within a global team.

• Experience working with an OEM, contract manufacturer, or external development partner would be an advantage.

• A solid understanding of relevant standards for medical electrical equipment, such as IEC 60601-1, IEC 60601-2-18, and ISO 80601-2-18, and experience translating regulatory and standards requirements into practical product development activities would also be an advantage

As Ambu is a global company, it is important that you communicate fluently in English. Only applications submitted in English will be considered.

**How To Apply

**We invite candidates for interviews on a continuous basis, so please do not hesitate to apply via our career site at ambu.com.

Your application will be treated confidentially.

_Please do not contact us or apply if you are a recruiter, consultant, or outsourcing company.

_Join a team of fintech heroes! 🚀

Performativ is changing the way investment advisors and financial institutions operate. We are building a modern platform for portfolio management, reporting, compliance, trading, and client engagement, replacing fragmented systems, manual workflows, and technology built for another era.

Our platform depends on accurate and timely data from custodians, banks, brokers, and other financial institutions. These connections provide the positions, transactions, cash movements, instruments, and corporate actions used throughout the investment-management lifecycle.

You can read more about our product at performativ.com.

As our new Software Engineer, Investment Data Integrations 📈

You will help build and operate the systems that connect Performativ with custodians and other providers of investment data.

The immediate challenge is practical: we need to deliver a growing number of integrations while maintaining the existing portfolio and resolving real production issues. The longer-term challenge is to avoid a scaling trap where every new institution requires another collection of manual processes and bespoke code.

We are building a more automated integration platform with reusable pipelines, mappings, reconciliation, quality controls, and AI-assisted development. Your work will contribute both to integrations customers need now and to the foundations that let the team deliver future integrations faster and more safely.

• You will develop and maintain integrations covering positions, transactions, cash, instruments, prices, corporate actions, and other investment data across files, APIs, SFTP, and message-based interfaces.

• You will build reusable ingestion, transformation, validation, reconciliation, and monitoring capabilities instead of treating each provider as an isolated implementation.

• You will investigate complex data and production issues across internal systems, external providers, and customer environments, then deliver permanent fixes that prevent known classes of problems from recurring.

• You will work closely with users, operations specialists, and other engineers to understand the complete workflow and ensure that integrated data is correct and useful throughout the platform.

• You will direct AI agents to produce much of the implementation, review their assumptions and output critically, and establish the tests, controls, and evidence required for safe deployment.

You should bring strong backend or data-engineering judgment and experience with production systems where correctness and reliability matter. Experience with financial integrations, investment data, reconciliation, ETL pipelines, APIs, structured files, or regulated systems would be valuable. Familiarity with technologies such as Python, Golang, PHP, TypeScript, MySQL, Redis, AWS, and CI/CD tooling is useful, but experience with our exact stack is not essential.

We value your passion 🔥

At Performativ, we are builders first. We have ambitious goals and value the time, judgment, and effort people put into their work. You will be trusted to make your mark and help shape how we solve difficult problems.

We do not divide the platform into personal territories. People develop deeper context in different areas, but we solve problems as a team. We expect people to lead when appropriate, follow through on what they take on, contribute to the work of others, and help teammates succeed.

AI can help us understand formats, generate mappings, develop implementations, and test integrations faster. It does not replace financial-domain understanding, careful validation, or accountability for the resulting data.

This role is based in Copenhagen. We work together primarily from our city-centre office, with flexibility to work from home when it makes sense. You should already be based in Copenhagen or be ready to relocate.

What we can offer you 🌱

• Work on integrations at the centre of a production wealth-management platform.

• Solve difficult problems involving financial data, external systems, reconciliation, reliability, and operational workflows.

• Help create an AI-assisted approach to developing and maintaining integrations safely at scale.

• An ambitious, collaborative team with experience from leading technology companies, consultancies, and financial institutions.

• Strong opportunities to deepen both your engineering capabilities and your understanding of investment management.

To Succeed In This Role, You

Join an inclusive community At Netcompany, we highly prioritize an inclusive community. We actively promote an open and welcoming work culture based on collaboration and mutual trust, where there is always an opportunity for sparring.

We offer a shared environment where we engage with each other across departments and projects. Additionally, we have a wide range of social and professional events that provide you with the best opportunities to expand your network.

Send us an application Upload your resume and a motivational letter to our recruitment system via the link. If you have unanswered questions, feel free to write to hr.dk@netcompany.com.

We are committed to creating an inclusive and diverse environment. Our recruitment processes are based on individual merit. About MicroTech Software

MicroTech is a small software company with more than 35 years of experience building custom solutions in close dialogue with our customers, mainly in banking and insurance. Since 2025, applying AI has been a major focus for us.

We value quality over quantity, and we keep the customer experience at the centre. Expect great colleagues and a busy but relaxed workday in an informal atmosphere. We also care about ESG and like to give back, for example through sponsorships and by being an inclusive workplace that welcomes employees who need special accommodations.

About the role

You’ll help shape the architecture of a live AI product running on our own on-prem LLM stack.

Two big projects are coming up, and you’ll play a key part in both:

• Voice-to-workflow: making speech a first-class input channel in our agentic workflows

• Moving to a graph architecture: going from RAG to GraphRAG by building a knowledge graph and integrating it into our existing pipeline

Responsibilities

Shape the architecture of a live AI product

• Evaluate and challenge design decisions across the stack, including retrieval strategies, LLM backend selection, service boundaries and data flow, and propose improvements with clear reasoning

• Take part in technical planning with the team and with insurance-domain stakeholders, turning vague requirements into concrete engineering tasks

• Identify technical debt, assess its cost and make the case for addressing it

Develop and optimize our on-prem AI stack

• Further develop and optimize our self-hosted LLM stack: local models, local embedding and on-prem vector stores

• Evaluate open-weight LLMs for Danish-language RAG quality, weighing latency, accuracy and hardware requirements

Move to a graph architecture (RAG → GraphRAG)

• Help design and build a knowledge graph for our domain, including ontology and knowledge extraction

• Integrate the knowledge graph into our existing RAG pipeline and measure the effect on retrieval quality

Design and build agentic workflows

• Design multi-step agent architectures using LangGraph or equivalent frameworks that can route, plan, use tools and synthesize across document corpora

• Define tool-use interfaces, memory patterns and failure-handling strategies for agent loops running in production

• Work with domain experts to identify automation opportunities worth building

Enable voice-to-workflow capabilities

• Help design a pipeline that integrates local speech-to-text models into agentic workflows

• Evaluate Danish-language ASR quality, identify gaps and assess whether fine-tuning or model selection is the better approach

• Design the integration points carefully, with attention to latency, error handling and data privacy, so voice becomes a first-class input channel

Requirements

• 2–4 years of production Python engineering experience, including async code, clean architecture patterns and testable codebases

• Direct experience with LLM orchestration frameworks (LangChain or similar) in a shipped product or serious project

• Solid understanding of RAG systems: chunking strategies, embedding models, vector search and retrieval quality evaluation

• Familiarity with vector databases such as pgvector, Chroma, Weaviate or Pinecone

• Comfortable owning a FastAPI service end-to-end: schema design, error handling, auth,

• containerization and deployment

• Ability to reason about architectural trade-offs and communicate them clearly

• Hands-on experience designing or running local LLM inference (Ollama, vLLM, llama.cpp) in a real rather than toy context

Nice to have

• Familiarity with knowledge graphs, including ontology building, knowledge extraction and RAG integration (especially relevant)

• Speech-to-text pipeline work (Whisper, Deepgram, Speechmatics or comparable local STT), especially on non-English languages (especially relevant)

• Experience with agentic frameworks (LangGraph, AutoGen, CrewAI) or custom tool-use and planning loops in production

• Hybrid retrieval systems (dense + sparse, BM25 + vector) and re-ranking with cross-encoders

• LLM observability and tracing tools (Arize Phoenix, LangSmith or similar)

• Multilingual NLP, particularly Danish or other Nordic languages

• Knowledge of regulated-industry data handling, GDPR or EU AI Act compliance

• Cloud platforms (e.g. Azure), container registries and CI/CD

What we offer
